verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story: a guide to generating and retrieving branded monthly account statements for customers [docs-13], and a guide to creating and filing a 1099-INT for an account [docs-38]. The evidence is thin single-line mentions, though, so automation details are not shown. Missing for 10: confirmation that statements are generated automatically per account each month, explicit API retrieval of 1099-INT documents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
